prayers.title: Acceptance Prayer
prayers.text:
Our mother and mother of Christ, we are happy and honored by your visit to our home, which you have made worthy to be the abode of our love and affection.

During your short stay with us, we humbly ask you to please bless our family and always abide with us through your graces. Give us, beloved mother, your blessings.

Bless this home and those members of our family who are away and deliver us from all evils. From now on we are consecrating our minds, our hearts and our works to you, since you are our mother, and grant that we may comply with the commandments of your son Jesus Christ and with the commandments of Mother Church.

We pledge to make this visit arouse us to a true love of God and to true devotion to you, so that we may fulfill our duties to ourselves, our neighbors, and to society. May peace reign in the world.

Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary, pray for us.
prayers.instruction: When receiving the image: a member of the host family prays this prayer. On other evenings, skip to Mary Comes to Our Home.

prayers.title: Mary Comes to Our Home
prayers.text:
℣. Let us pray well "as if our Blessed Lady herself instead of her statue, is visibly present among us".
℟. For love of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph, let us pray slowly and from the heart.

℣. "and Jesus told them a parable, to the effect they ought always to pray and not to lose heart." (Lk 18:1)
℟. Lord Jesus, Savior of the world, "teach us how to pray." (Lk 11:1)

℣. "and Jesus answered them, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you receive it, and you will. Forgive if you have anything against anyone, so that your father, also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses" (Mk 11:24-25)
℟. We humbly ask all the holy angels and saints to join us now in prayer.

Help us carry our cross to Calvary as Jesus did. Show us how to love one another as Jesus commanded. Fill our hearts with purity and modesty. Fill our minds with holy thoughts especially the Word of God found in the Gospels. Send holy angels to watch over us, to protect us from the hatred of the evil one. Send the saints to inspire us, to do all the greater honor and glory of God. Pray to the Blessed Trinity, the Father, Son and Holy Spirit that we might become holy and pleasing in their sight. Amen.
prayers.instruction: Please stand. The leader reads ℣ and all respond ℟. Bible verse references need not be read aloud.

prayers.title: Immaculate Mother
prayers.text:
Immaculate Mother, to you do we plead,
to ask God, our Father, for help in our need.
Ave, Ave, Ave Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave Maria!

We pray for our country, the land of our birth;
we pray for all nations, that peace be on earth.
Ave, Ave, Ave Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave Maria!

prayers.title: Welcome to Mary
prayers.text:
℣. The Mother of Jesus has come to this home. Let us give her a warm welcome.
℟. "Hail Mary, full of grace! The Lord Jesus is with you." (Lk 1:28)

℣. Mary always greets God's children with words of love. Let us listen!
℟. Mary entered the house and greeted Elizabeth. And when Elizabeth heard the greetings of Mary, the baby in her womb leapt for joy. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit. (Lk 1:40-41)

℣. How beautiful that the Mother of the Lord Jesus has come to this home. Let us humbly say to Mary:
℟. "Why is this granted to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?" (Lk 1:43)

℣. There can be but one reason for Mary's visit.
℟. His mother said to the servant, "Do whatever Jesus tells you." (Jn 2:5)

℣. Is this not the way the most obedient Virgin Mary, beloved daughter of the Heavenly Father, always speaks? How did she answer God's messenger, Gabriel? Listen!
℟. "And Mary said, behold! The servant girl of the Lord, let it be done to me according to your word." (Lk 1:38)

℟. And blessed are those who love and honor the Mother of Jesus Christ, our Lord and Savior, Mary, the Immaculate Virgin of Nazareth.
prayers.instruction: The leader reads ℣ and all respond ℟. Bible verse references need not be read aloud.

prayers.title: And Mary Said
prayers.text:
℣. "My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my savior." (Lk 1:46-47)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "For He has regarded the humility of His handmaid, for behold! Henceforth, all generations shall call me blessed." (Lk 1:48)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "For He who is mighty has done great things for me, and Holy is His name." (Lk 1:49)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "And His mercy is from age to age on those who fear Him. He has shown strength with His arm; He has scattered the proud in the conceit of their hearts." (Lk 1:50-51)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "He has put down the mighty from their thrones and exalted the humble." (Lk 1:52)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "He has filled the hungry with good things, and the rich He has sent empty away" (Lk 1:53)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "He has helped Israel, His servant, in remembrance of His mercy." (Lk 1:54)
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "As He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed forever."
℟. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee!

℣. "And Mary stayed in the home of Elizabeth about three months." (Lk 1:56)
prayers.instruction: The leader reads ℣ and all respond ℟. Bible verse references need not be read aloud.

prayers.title: The Most Holy Rosary
prayers.text:
℣. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
℟. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

℣. O Lord, open my lips.
℟. And my mouth shall proclaim thy praise.

℣. O God, come to my assistance.
℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
prayers.instruction: All kneel, as circumstances permit. The leader reads ℣ and all respond ℟.

prayers.title: Invocation of the Miraculous Medal
prayers.text:
℣. O Mary, conceived without sin,
℟. Pray for us, who have recourse to thee.
prayers.instruction: This may be prayed after reciting the Fatima Prayer after each decade.

prayers.title: Prayer after the Litany
prayers.text:
℣. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

℣. Let us pray.

℟. Grant unto us, thy servants, we beseech Thee, Oh Lord God, at all times to enjoy health of soul and body. And by the glorious intercession of the Blessed Mary, ever virgin, when freed from the sorrows of this present life, to enter into that joy which has no end, through Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.instruction: The leader reads ℣ and all respond ℟.

prayers.title: Family Prayer
prayers.text: ℟. Dearest Mother Mary, most beautiful Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, we humbly beg you – stay with us now, today, tomorrow and forever. This home is yours. Teach us how to be true and faithful children of God, to obey humbly our heavenly father, to love Jesus more than all other creatures, to respect our bodies as true temples of the Holy Spirit. Teach us how to pray always. Teach us how to accept suffering as the royal road to heaven.

prayers.title: Give Thanks
prayers.text:
Give thanks with a grateful heart,
Give thanks to the Holy One,
Give thanks, because He has given Jesus Christ, His Son.

And now let the weak say “I am strong.”
Let the poor say “I am rich”
Because of what the Lord has done for us,
Give thanks.

prayers.title: Farewell Prayer
prayers.text:
℟. O beloved Mother, the time has come, for your departure from our home, your home also during your stay with us. Our lips cannot express the joy overflowing in our hearts. Inspired by your love Mother, you desired to be with us, even for only a while.

Thank you, Mother. Thank you. Come back some other day. We will wait for you with profound ardor. Upon your departure, take with you our hearts. Never allow us to forget you nor to stray away from your care now and forever. Amen.
prayers.instruction: When passing the image to the next home: a member of the host family prays this prayer. On other evenings, skip to the Sign of the Cross.
